summary:
Updated implementation plan with:
- Security Vault Hub in Sidebar & Dashboard: Master Password entry shield (with PIN/Passkey simulation), obfuscated secret values with on-demand reveal, category filters, encrypted notes manager, and tamper-proof immutable access audit logs.
- App-Grade Shared Life Domains View: Transformed document reading from raw Markdown into an interactive, beautifully formatted App experience with live interactive checklist checkboxes, syntax-highlighted terminal code blocks with 1-click copy, styled quote callouts, and domain related-notes shelf.
- Dashboard Visual Definition & Contrast: Strengthened all card borders to 2px solid contrast borders with top-accent quadrant indicator stripes (Indigo for Calendar, Emerald for Tasks, Sky for Mailbox, Amber for News, Red for Security Vault) and elevated card styling.
